offering_description.value: B&G Foods sells packaged foods to grocery retailers, wholesale distributors, and foodservice customers. It makes products in its own facilities and uses contract manufacturers for some lines.

primary_products.value: cooking oils and baking ingredients; spices and seasonings; hot cereals and syrups; taco shells, sauces and condiments; canned beans and pickled vegetables

customer_segment.value: B2B: grocery chains, mass merchants, warehouse clubs, wholesalers and foodservice distributors

end_markets.value: retail groceries; restaurant and institutional foodservice

revenue_model.value: product sales: packaged foods purchased by retailers, wholesalers and foodservice distributors

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: turns purchased oils, grains, spices and other ingredients into packaged foods for retailers and distributors; brand owner: sources finished foods from contract manufacturers and markets them to retailers and distributors

geography_served.value: North America: United States, Canada and Puerto Rico

specialization.value: related lines: cooking and baking staples, seasonings, breakfast foods, Mexican meal ingredients and shelf-stable foods

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: company sales teams serving grocery chains and other major accounts; distributors / dealers: grocery wholesalers and foodservice distributors; third-party retail: supermarkets, mass merchants and warehouse clubs; agents / brokers: independent food brokers serving retail accounts
distribution_channels.category: direct sales; distributors / dealers; third-party retail; agents / brokers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: FDA and Canadian food safety, manufacturing and labeling requirements

notes: The current scope of the vegetable portfolio is uncertain following divestitures.
